services.name: Siesta Key fishing
services.desc: The Gulf was showing off this week! With bluebird skies, glassy calm seas, and just enough breeze to keep things comfortable, the crew aboard Reel Addiction SRQ went on the hunt for some serious offshore action out of Sarasota with Capt. Jason at the helm. Red Snapper - A stunning 18-20 lb trophy lit up the deck with its bright crimson color. This hard-fighting beauty is a fan favorite both for the fight and the fillets. Snowy Grouper - At an estimated 25-28 lbs, this deepwater beast put our anglers to the test. Known for their powerful runs and exceptional taste, Snowy Grouper are always a special catch. services.desc: Winter is peak season for sheepshead, a favorite among Sarasota fishing charters. Found around docks, bridges, seawalls, and reefs, these “convict fish” are known for their strong bite and excellent table fare.
